notes.title: IDUN Major Update & Steam Spring Sale – Get 15% Off!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/c0fe8eaee853ed7945f09275edd262dd7e3aa7db.gif[/img]

IDUN hits Build 100 with a massive update! A new cinematic wraps up the story, and Ro-Ro joins as a deployable hero after finishing the campaign. Extreme Difficulty & Epic Raids unlocks for those who seek the ultimate challenge. Rock Piercer is now a fully implemented hero! The game is now fully localized in Russian and Korean, big thanks to everyone who helped out! 

[b]We're currently part of the Steam Spring Sale! IDUN is now available at a 15% discount, so if you’ve enjoyed Prologue, now’s the perfect time to jump into the full experience![/b]

[b]Ready for the next challenge? Upgrade from Prologue to the full game now and experience everything IDUN has to offer! [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186360/IDUN/

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New cinematic when finishing the last mission (Drill or Die).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/fadd60e05dabdf28fa69634df183ac5bf32b921b.jpg[/img]

[*] Ro-Ro becomes a deployable hero after completing the story campaign. Play Drill or Die to unlock!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/2c6648c61283ed9f6b01a42b1f3e0ab9a28e5ddf.gif[/img]

[*] Full localization in Russian and Korean.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/6d5ec5401f13adf58fb7a87cc8767a52bd83fcad.jpg[/img]

[*] Extreme Difficulty unlocks after finishing the story campaign. Survive Deep Drill for 10 minutes, mine 95% with the Excavator, and collect 10 meteors with the Mech.
[*] Epic-length Raids unlock after the story campaign. Almost twice as long as Long Raids!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/a7c507b908a6db2d5c737e069342156d036ce724.png[/img]

[*] Rock Piercer is now an upgradeable hero with deployable abilities. Play Convoy to unlock.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/8fc8621756c75a0df83614bbcbb2fdc55c2337b1.gif[/img]
[/list]

This is a huge milestone for IDUN, and it's all thanks to you! Keep sharing your feedback, and let me know what you think of the new heroes and epic challenges!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 0.91 "Re-Rolls & Bans"
notes.notes:
Take control of your rewards with the new Re-roll and Ban systems, improved mission balancing, and significant fixes based on player feedback. Explore a more polished experience with better visual and enhanced gameplay options.

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pink cursor option.
[*] Screen Resolution dropdown in Settings.
[*] Slow Motion (Reduced Game Speed) toggle can now be bound to a key in Settings.
[*] Reward Re-roll: Refresh your options with a limited number of re-rolls per mission.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/47c4ed32a6ad26ac64df861e9a85f019b82a72e5.jpg[/img]
[*] Reward Ban: Remove a reward option for the rest of the mission with a limited number of bans per mission.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/a0b31be6ad0506974b7714b9ced146459b2f3ac9.jpg[/img]
[*] Pre-Lightning Strike warning effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/e736507010d9da7a640208f011c318b5ac7fcffa.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Walls start count increased from 1 to 3.
[*] Deep Drill minimum distance from edges increased from 10 to 20 meters.
[*] Deep Drill Smallest mission smallest size increased from 60 to 70.
[*] Nuke On Wheels trigger distance increased from 8 to 8.5.
[*] Spear Spitters stand closer to targets (distance reduced from 400 to 300).
[*] Mech Mission Meteor collection reward distance increased from 10 to 12.
[*] Lightning Strike won't hit the same spot twice in a row.
[*] Excavator changes:
[list]
[*] Epli reward from mining mountains increased by 33%.
[*] Health increased from 10000 to 12000
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Analytics data collection is now off by default.
[*] Time between dormant spawn wave warnings increased from 30 to 40 seconds.
[*] Holding Shift with Traditional controls always triggers box selection (no accidental dragging).
[*] Turret Tooltip now displays Aim Speed (Rotation Rate).
[*] Selection Modifier input is now rebindable (default: Shift).
[*] Control Group input is now rebindable (default: CTRL). Press CTRL + # to create control groups.
[*] Updated Raid information screenshots.
[*] Mech Proximity Mine on step no longer exponential.
[*] No Monster Tunnel openings on small maps.
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Mech Collectibles can't be moved with dragged turrets or hero destination targets.
[*] UI toggle for "Send Analytics Data" shows the correct state (off by default).
[*] Wall health upgrades apply properly.
[*] Bomber Cooldown reduction functions correctly.
[*] Soldier Air printing uses the correct base value.
[*] Droppable items no longer disappear if dropped on invalid locations too quickly.
[*] Nuke On Wheels Mission shows correct time on objectives before starting.
[*] Full-screen mode setting now works.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/5e7d175d10ea41ebfedf60be983e12bc81080b63.gif[/img]

Thank you so much for playing the Prologue. I would highly recommend you to check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186360/]IDUN[/url] for more awesomeness!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186360/IDUN/

After the official launch of our game, we’ve received attention from players all over the world. Many players from certain regions have expressed a strong desire for localized versions in their native languages. To address this, we are actively working with new translation companies to make this happen. In the first phase, we will be adding [b]Korean, Russian, and other localized languages.[/b]

We’re excited about the possibility of more players around the world enjoying the game in their native language. If you’d like to see your language added, please let us know in the comments so we can carefully evaluate the demand—your feedback is invaluable!

As an indie team, our resources are limited, so if you’re interested in contributing as a volunteer translator, your help would be greatly appreciated in speeding up the process. If you’d like to get involved, feel free to leave a comment or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/KRXDNETCnh][b]Discord[/b][/url] to discuss this with us. Thank you!!!

notes.title: IDUN has 🚀Launched, Play Now!
notes.notes:
Hi all! I’m absolutely thrilled to share that IDUN has officially launched and is ready to play!

IDUN is a single-player defense focused RTS with a story campaign and rogue-lite elements. Available now on Windows, MacOS, Linux, and SteamDeck for $14.99 USD! For the next two weeks, you can grab it at a 10% launch discount! Pick it up and let us know what you think. Your continued feedback will shape the future of the game, so please share your thoughts and ideas with us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186360

Creating IDUN has been an incredible journey. This game is a passion project brought to life by an amazing team of talented people from around the globe. I love making games so much I forget to breathe, and my 18 years in the industry have only deepened that passion. Talking with the community has been a highlight of this process, and your feedback has been instrumental in making IDUN the game it is today, so thank you!

[previewyoutube=2eea98br6hc;full][/previewyoutube]

The Prologue was a crazy idea and a wild ride, but your reception blew us away! It's still being updated and supported, so I would highly recommend you to give it a spin if you haven't already.

IDUN is also part of the Steam RTS Fest, a perfect chance to feel it's unique mix of defense-focused RTS and rogue-lite gameplay. My love for the RTS genre knows no bounds, which I hope you can feel when you play IDUN.

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
The launch is only the beginning. We’re committed to keeping IDUN fresh with regular updates and exciting new content based on your feedback.

It’s been an unforgettable journey creating this game, and I’m so excited for you to play what we’ve made!

Cheers,
Gustav ("The Developer") & the IDUN Team

notes.title: Ready to Roll? The IDUN Launch FAQ!
notes.notes:
[b]IDUN[/b] is officially launching on [b]January 20th[/b], and we’ve prepared an FAQ to help answer any questions you might have. Thank you for your incredible support—we couldn’t have done this without you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186360/IDUN/

[b]Q: What is the exact launch time?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]January 20th at [b]9:00 AM PST.[/b]

[b]Q: Will it launch in Early Access?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]No, the full game will be available at launch!

[b]Q: What’s the price? Will there be a launch discount?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]The game is priced at [b]$14.99[/b] and will have a [b]10% launch discount.[/b]

[b]Q: Can I stream the game after it’s released?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]Absolutely! We encourage you to stream and share all the content freely.

[b]Q: What modes are included in the game?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]The game features [b]Campaign Story Mode[/b] and a [b]Roguelike Raid Mode.[/b]

[b]A: [/b]Yes, we will continue to support the game with updates after launch, including balance adjustments, bug fixes, and more. We’re also looking forward to hearing player feedback to inspire new content in future updates.

[b]Q: How can I provide feedback or suggestions?[/b]
[b]A:[/b]
[list]
[*] In-game feedback window
[*] Discord: https://discord.com/invite/KRXDNETCnh
[*] Steam Community
[/list]

I can't believe it—our game is finally about to officially launch! Let's look forward to the arrival of the full build together! We are incredibly grateful for all the support from our players and we couldn’t have done it without you!

Best wishes!

notes.title: IDUN’s FREE Prologue Is Now Available – Play Raid Mode Early!
notes.notes:
Still eagerly awaiting IDUN?

We’re excited to announce the official release of the IDUN Prologue, a standalone free version before the full game's launch. Unlike a demo, the Prologue introduces an entirely new Raid Mode, giving you an early glimpse into the roguelike gameplay. The full story campaign and complete Raid content will be available in the official full release on January 20th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/33222fcca63e7f8d2671aff68145cf41c0711457.jpg[/img]

Earlier, we also released a significant update for the DEMO. The new DEMO features more polished graphics and user guidance, including support for Steam Deck, bringing it closer to the quality of the final game. We encourage you to try it again! Of course, this content has also been integrated into the Prologue, where you can experience it through the "Tutorial."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/e1f6bc3ec6db91725c8c1a054984489cae4db019.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/bbbc575bbb178697101260456945525761cfea6b.jpg[/img]

We’re now in the final stages of polishing and optimizing the full version of IDUN. After the release, we’ll continue to deliver updates and improvements based on player feedback. Your opinions are invaluable to us, so please share your thoughts through the Steam Community, Discord, or Twitter to help us make the game even better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/2547c959b526ec1e5204bc7cea6ffe5df5a07cac.jpg[/img]

We also welcome you to leave a review of the Prologue—it means a lot to us. Thank you so much for playing!

If you enjoy the game, we’d greatly appreciate it if you could add the full version to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186360

notes.title: IDUN Now Fully Supports Steam Deck – Get Ready to Play Anywhere!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to share some exciting news today - IDUN is now fully compatible with Steam Deck!

This is something we’re really excited about. Many of us here are huge Steam Deck fans. Initially, we couldn't imagine having such a great gaming experience on a handheld PC, but once we got our hands on it, we were hooked – it’s such a magical gaming experience! We can pick it up and put it down anytime, enjoying the game anywhere we go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/6761e553bcdd3c34c06b259311dfb647d7c9aadd.png[/img]

So, if you already own a Steam Deck, you’ll be able to play the Prologue or the full game directly on it when it's released. Of course, this also means we’ve fully supported controller play, so if you prefer to use a controller on PC or use other handheld devices like the ROG Ally, you’re all set!

With the holiday season approaching, we wish you all a joyful holiday!

Lastly, just a friendly reminder: our free Prologue will be officially available on January 2, 2025, and the full game will launch on January 20, 2025!

Please add the Prologue to your wishlist – we truly appreciate your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3116470/IDUN/

[previewyoutube=w7vrVYD5IQc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Introducing IDUN's brand new key visuals - take a look!
notes.notes:
Hello, Commanders!

We're thrilled to announce the launch of brand new key visuals for both IDUN and IDUN: Prologue! We hope you'll love them as much as we do.

We've adopted two completely different visual styles for the Prologue and the main game. The Prologue features a vibrant, anime-inspired design, while the main game version has a more traditional sci-fi style - hardcore yet stunningly cool!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/b4f94c4361e260347ea5ebeb5823296974fb56fb.jpg[/img]
[b][i]Prologue's Key Art[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/a39264c2799af7e3637495a8b97db763addf63af.jpg[/img]
[b][i]Main Game's Key Art[/i][/b]

This is also our way of saying how much we value the Prologue game. Prologue is not just a simple demo but a "final rehearsal" leading up to the full release. You can even think of it as a standalone indie game. The Prologue is set to release in the first week of January 2025. We'd really appreciate it if you'd add it to your Steam wishlist, which will help us climb the Steam Popular Upcoming chart and draw more attention to our work. Thank you for your support!

Even more exciting news is on the way - we're actively preparing the game's official release trailer. The exact release dates for both the Prologue and the full game will be revealed soon. Stay tuned!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186360/IDUN/

notes.title: Come See How Much We've Changed!
notes.notes:
Hello, IDUN fans!

In our last announcement we mentioned that we were preparing something special. Starting today, we'll be gradually revealing these exciting updates to all of you. Yes, we've been working hard to make IDUN better than ever!

[b]Improved and Enhanced Visuals[/b]

As development progresses, we’ve continued to improve and enhance the game’s visuals. As you know, IDUN is named after the Norse goddess of youth, and our story begins as humanity sets foot on a planet named in her honor. The campaign and levels will unfold on this beautiful planet.

In the upcoming free Prologue, you’ll be able to see IDUN’s evolution firsthand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/aa447105f8e0271673e12c1a97bbbb533c183d19.jpg[/img]
[b]This is IDUN in the DEMO[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/df399c0bc44c3555e990dced4506014c5eabfe94.gif[/img]
[b]This is IDUN in the Prologue[/b]

As you can see, the planet IDUN will become more vivid, and the graphics have been significantly upgraded.

[b]Storytelling and Character Development[/b]

In addition to visual improvements, the storytelling and character development are also key focuses of our recent work. Today, we’re thrilled to announce that Ro-ro has officially joined as a playable character! As a key figure in driving the story, Ro-ro will appear in both the Prologue and the full version of the game.

[previewyoutube=Vx3w-nFK3Fc;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay tuned as we continue to introduce new content and changes to the game. Please add the Prologue to your Wish List - it is incredibly important to us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3116470/IDUN/
